independence: The reviewer did not author the T29 product or test fixes and made no product/test changes during this review.
scope: Final independent component-quality review of the exact clean ab5ccc8 candidate: all 71 narrow dark/RTL/200%-root-text captures, representative desktop layouts, the all-component source/installed-consumer path, and the exact WebKit catalog/data/compound/visualization interaction slice.

acceptedChanges: The Select catalog fixture now uses the Team domain with Research and Product options and the Research value.
Investigation gives its trend panel the full grid width so its chart and exact-data table remain usable on desktop.
Stack, Grid and Select preserved source snippets remain lexically aligned with their executable authored mounts.

sourceReview.unrelatedChanges: No unrelated source was changed by this review. Existing scenario traceability changes in the reviewed commit range were outside T29 and were not used as T29 evidence.

narrow.observations: Essential content remains present without document overflow; logical RTL ordering is coherent; large text reflows rather than clipping; chart/table containment, label separation, contrast and touch targets are acceptable.

desktop.observations: The Team Select is domain-correct and the Investigation trend, chart, caption and nine-column exact-data table occupy the full available width without overflow or cramped character wrapping. Representative component families remain coherent.

remainingIncompleteDisposition: Menu and Popover aria-controls targets exist inside their open shadow roots and expose the expected expanded menu/dialog semantics; Axe cannot resolve these four cross-shadow references.

The remaining contrast indeterminates concern SVG text, glyph-only labels or responsive cells whose backgrounds Axe reports as image/partially obscured. Direct contrast checks establish 14.39:1 for Tree labels and 8.90:1 for Treemap labels; the remaining visible labels were inspected in both reviewed variants and no unresolved contrast defect remains.
accessibilityReview.manualAssistiveTechnology: Not performed and not claimed. Scenario S28 remains deferredForRelease=true and planned.
